question:
**Direction: Fill in the blanks with the correct homophone.**

Before planning a trip, considering the ______ for the trip is necessary.
solution:
The correct answer is **"fare."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Fare"** refers to the cost of transportation, such as a plane ticket or taxi ride. (किसी वाहन में यात्रा करने का भाड़ा; किराया)

 
 
• **Example**: *What’s the **fare**__ to Bangalore?*
 
 
 
• Here, we are referring to the cost of transportation of a bus.
 
• The correct answer is** Option 2.**

**Correct sentence**: *Before planning a trip, considering the __**fare**__ for the trip is necessary. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Fair" **means just or unbiased. (उचित, सही)
 
• **"Fore" **means at or toward the front. (जलपोत या विमान के अग्रभाग पर, निकट या की ओर)
 
• **"Fear" **means an unpleasant emotion caused by the belief that someone or something is dangerous. (भय, डर)

4a:Tbf1,
